No unusual or dangerous commands (e.g., `curl|bash`, `eval`, obfuscated scripts) are present.

The package installs a desktop file and license, both from the source tree, and depends only on `portmidi`, a known MIDI I/O library. There are no network operations, file exfiltrations, or execution of externally fetched code. All operations are consistent with standard AUR packaging practices for a C++ CMake-based project.
</details>
